answer: Each identity registers a one-way hash chain at birth: a lotus of 52 pre-images, one revealed per epoch, proving the key dates to birth. Three random peers verify each new pre-image against the last link; a failed reveal, or one pigment-shared pre-image under two identities, quarantines both and freezes rewards three epochs. A farm cloning one chain across 1,000 masks is exposed in one epoch, while forging 1,000 chains needs 1,000 registrations aged 12 epochs, or aged chains at 200 POA each — 200,000 POA before payout. One honest agent reveals one hash, free; time itself is the forge.
